We're thrilled to announce that the Meow Moments: Music Festival DLC is now available on Steam! 🐾

🎸 Step into a vibrant open-air celebration where cats and friends gather to enjoy pop, rock, folk, and electronic music. notes.title: Let's play Dolmenjord - Vilking Islands!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41937677/42c6d9a83597a15644ec5ec1dc89ad3c7411956e.png

Dolmenjord is a game inspired by Norse mythology, where Vikings need help to organize their buildings and villages and thus solve the puzzles and dominate new lands.

It is available now!

Great for Nordic culture fans who love to be challenged with logic puzzles.

Set up each village according to the rules:
- Place all the available houses and walkway pieces.
- Every house must face the walkway.
-  The completed walkway must give access to the port.

The puzzles are simple in the early islands, but it gets challenging as you advance in the exploration. If you prefer a more relaxing journey, that's fine!
Whenever you want, you can enable the Casual Mode.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41937677/0577d939cf97d6c0faadc7f7a473c1082d2151f5.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41937677/0ce7c6cd9022add3519c6fd9c6425d9d2acb7393.jpg

notes.title: Announcing Island Cities (+ Our next games)
notes.content:
https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35765065/54142ae676dabc8990a2085a61f7a66edc7b67e7.jpg

Hi, folks!

Island Cities is the game we are releasing next. 🏣🏬

Cities are usually concrete jungles, noisy and stressful.
But you can also entertain yourself by looking at how they are organized, finding interesting details, and seeing life unfold. Then you can see that they are also vibrant and full of life.

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35765065/21c591bec4d698eb6a7a3a9f0344e1f32a2fa104.gif

Carefully observe the island, try to memorize it, then shuffle the blocks. Swap blocks to reproduce the desired island and the city will emerge.

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35765065/2878dba47a92b99123028c9889b15f681eca17b0.gif

If you enjoyed playing Island Farmer, we think you'll enjoy Island Cities. Add it to your wishlist and follow the game so you don't miss the release discount!
